news.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 Results: Profit skyrockets 407% YoY to Rs 375 crore, NII rises 81%
news.description: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a 407% year-on-year surge in Q2FY27 profit to Rs 375 crore, while net interest income rose 81%. Operating profit more than doubled, supported by business growth, improving asset quality and an expanded gold loan network.

news.title: Half of India’s MTF book is in smallcaps; Nithin Kamath flags liquidity risks
news.description: Zerodha founder Nithin Kamath warned that small and microcap stocks account for a substantial share of India’s margin trading facility book. He highlighted liquidity risks during market downturns, when smaller stocks may face sharper selling pressure.

news.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0 | SIFs, passive funds and GIFT City: How India's wealth portfolios are evolving, says Tata AMC's Anand Vardarajan
news.description: Tata Asset Management CEO Anand Vardarajan highlights how passive funds, SIFs and GIFT City are reshaping wealth management. He advocates combining active and passive strategies while monitoring global yields, inflation and valuations to build diversified portfolios.
